description: Ministry of Justice Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms - Rules Council of Legal Education Ordinance Chapter 276
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the rescission of rules made under the Council of Legal Education Ordinance (Chapter 276) by Parliament. It deals specifically with legal rules, their parliamentary disapproval, and rescission, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (new laws, regulations, amendments, repeals, or modifications). While it mentions the Minister of Justice, it does so only in the context of the rule-making process and does not involve government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government-related classification.
